## ACCENT\_COLOR variable

The CSS custom property holding the visualization accent — the one saturated colour the library reserves for "you can interact with this" (hover outlines, selection strokes, the MSA cursor cross-hair). Defined for both themes in the shipped stylesheet, so SVG can use it directly and follow light/dark for free.

**Signature:**

```typescript
ACCENT_COLOR = "var(--rbv-accent)"
```
